name: /sdd:implement: updates the plan's existing Progress Summary instead of adding one
prompt:
/sdd:implement .specs/docs/plans/2026-09-12-audit-trail.md "Phase 1 - Append-only log"

Stop after marking the section active and appending a log entry saying work has started. Do not write any source code and do not commit.

graders.why: the plan already has a table after Quick Links; a second one means one of them silently goes stale
the existing Phase 1 row is the one to update, matched by number rather than by the full section title
plans call the log Progress Tracking; renaming it to the task files' Progress Notes breaks the plan template's contract
graders.lint_ignore: the heading is present before the run by design: this grader checks it survives, so a pre-run match is the precondition rather than vacuity

graders.why: appending to a new Progress Notes section beside the existing log splits the history in two
